$comment: The CLI <-> UI parity ledger for Pact (PFX-8.2, #7299). Every `apiome pact` command has a screen, and every Contracts write route has a command.

commands: one row per command in apiome-cli/pact-commands.json (regenerate it with `cd apiome-cli && uv run python scripts/export_pact_commands.py`). `ui` is the page (an App Router route under apiome-ui/src/app) where the same action is done; when there is none yet, `ui` is null and `reason` says why and which ticket adds it.

writeRoutes: one row per POST / PUT / PATCH / DELETE handler under apiome-ui/src/app/api/pact. `ui` is the page that sends it; `cli` is the `apiome pact` command that does the same, or null with a `reason`.
apiome-ui/tests/pact-parity-ledger.test.ts enforces both directions. See apiome-docs/docs/admin/contribute-to-the-docs.mdx (The CLI <-> UI parity ledger).

A command row may carry `fields`: every argument and flag of the command, and the control on `ui` that sets it (PFX-8.3, #7300). When present, the gate holds it to the command's arguments and options exactly.

writeRoutes.reason: Re-runs one recorded pact version. `apiome pact verify` starts a run from selectors and cannot name a single pact version; a command for it would be a new `verify` option, not yet designed.
Verify all stale is a console shortcut over recorded results; in a pipeline `apiome pact verify` with the default selectors re-verifies the same pacts.
Compare only is a read: it reports what a publish would record and stores nothing. No apiome pact command runs it yet; a pipeline publishes and reads can-i-deploy instead.
A standing source is set once, not per build: apiome pact publish-provider-contract publishes one version, and a pipeline that publishes every version needs no standing source.
A person answering a re-publish request in the console; the request is closed by publishing the pact again, which `apiome pact publish` does.
Workspace verification settings are edited on the Settings page only; no `apiome pact` command manages them yet.
Workspace verification settings are edited on the Settings page only; no `apiome pact` command manages them yet.
Workspace verification settings are edited on the Settings page only; no `apiome pact` command manages them yet.
Pact CLI's `test-webhook` has no `apiome pact` counterpart yet; the REST route is in the command block of the webhook page.
Pact CLI has no delete-webhook command and `apiome pact` follows it; the REST route is the scripted way.
Pact CLI's `create-or-update-webhook` has no `apiome pact` counterpart yet; the editor's command block shows the REST call.
Redelivering one failed firing is a console action on the delivery log; no `apiome pact` command reads deliveries yet.
Test sends an unsaved webhook once from the editor; Pact CLI's `test-webhook` has no `apiome pact` counterpart yet.
Stop run ends a live run started from the page; apiome pact verify runs in the pipeline, where cancelling the job stops it.
Re-run this interaction is a quick check inside a finished live run and publishes nothing; apiome pact verify re-verifies whole pacts and records results.
The preview is a read: it lists what a run would verify and sends nothing. apiome pact verify --no-publish-verification-results is the pipeline's dry run, and it replays.
Restoring is an undo from the Delete dialog or the Deleted view; pact-broker has no such command, and a pipeline that deleted by mistake restores with the REST request.
No apiome pact command labels a pacticipant (pact-broker has none); a pipeline adds a label with the REST request.
No apiome pact command removes a pacticipant label (pact-broker has none); a pipeline removes one with the REST request.
No `apiome pact` command changes an environment yet (pact-broker update-environment has no Apiome twin); the Edit environment dialog shows the REST request instead.
No `apiome pact` command deletes an environment yet (pact-broker delete-environment has no Apiome twin); the Delete environment dialog shows the REST request instead.
